## UI extensions

Django UI extensions (XUI). Each folder has a README.

| Extension | ID | Description |
|---|---|---|
| AWS EKS Cluster | [XUI-8a1jocmr](extensions/XUI-8a1jocmr/README.md) | Adds Cluster, Node groups, Workloads, and Groups tabs to AWS EKS cluster resources with live cluster and add-on status, a Kubernetes upgrade banner, node group scaling and deletion, per-node and per-namespace workload figures, and management of the CloudBolt groups that may order namespaces on the cluster, and Connect and Workloads tabs to Kubernetes namespace landing zones with kubectl access details and a live inventory. |
| Azure AKS Cluster | [XUI-nr5iiu60](extensions/XUI-nr5iiu60/README.md) | Adds Cluster, Node pools, Workloads, and Groups tabs to Azure Kubernetes Service cluster resources with the portal's essentials and properties, upgrades, integrations, node pool scaling, upgrade, and deletion, per-node and per-namespace workload figures, and the CloudBolt groups that may order namespaces on the cluster, and Connect and Workloads tabs to AKS namespace landing zones with kubectl access details and a live inventory. |
| Azure NSG Management | [XUI-0jdk7t6h](extensions/XUI-0jdk7t6h/README.md) | Adds a Security Rules tab to Azure network security group resources with the NSG's essentials and associations and its inbound and outbound rules, which users with permission can add, edit, and delete. |
| Azure Patches | [XUI-6nzs882l](extensions/XUI-6nzs882l/README.md) | Adds a Patching server tab to Azure VMs that shows the latest patch assessment and runs scan and apply jobs. |
| Content Package Manager | [XUI-iq65xgvr](extensions/XUI-iq65xgvr/README.md) | Adds a Content Packages admin page for defining named sets of blueprints, actions, plugins, shared modules, UI extensions, standalone parameters, and Runbooks workflows, and for exporting, syncing, or importing each set through CloudBolt's own per-object repository push and sync. |

## Parameters

Standalone parameters that content packages list. Source Control Repos does not sync them: the Content Package Manager extension writes each folder when it exports a package and creates or updates the parameter by name when it syncs one.

| Parameter | ID | Description | Name | Type | Options generated by |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Data Disks | [CF-q3bexgap](parameters/CF-q3bexgap/README.md) | Data disks to add to the server, as a JSON list: one entry per disk with drive_letter (Windows) or mount_point (Linux), size_gb, and volume_name. | `disk_map` | TXT |  |
| Domain OU | [CF-8pif9mbf](parameters/CF-8pif9mbf/README.md) | Specific OU to join the domain. Will only be used if the 'Domain to Join' is specified. | `domain_ou` | STR | [Suggest Domain OUs](orchestration_actions/HPA-0zcrvpwu/README.md) |

| Function | ID | Description | Form |

| azpsBuildScriptPanel | [FJS-ouuq5zsq](form_functions/FJS-ouuq5zsq/) | Async form function shared by the order forms of the two Azure PowerShell blueprints (the build-item prefix is its optional second argument): fetches the chosen script's input fields from the azps-script-panel webhook and installs them as the Script Parameters Dynamic Panel's template, resolving instantly on re-evaluation while the panel already matches the chosen script. | [Run an Azure PowerShell Script](forms/FRM-mfveruw6/), [Run an Azure PowerShell Script (Deployment Script)](forms/FRM-qfupiiyj/) |
| dataDiskLetterFree | [FJS-sq7c76cc](form_functions/FJS-sq7c76cc/) | Form function for the Windows Server with Data Disks order form: hides a drive letter in a Data Disks row once another row uses it. | [Windows Server with Data Disks](forms/FRM-jqnr84d0/) |
| dataDiskMapForm | [FJS-1h4v6wx2](form_functions/FJS-1h4v6wx2/) | Async form function that turns an environment's disk_map parameter into a Data Disks table whose columns follow the selected OS build, writing the rows back to disk_map as a JSON list. | [Server with Data Disks](forms/FRM-58d5rxg8/) |

| runbookWorkflowItems | [FJS-hufo9zd4](form_functions/FJS-hufo9zd4/) | Async form function for blueprint custom forms with Run Workflow build items: replaces each item's Workflow inputs box with a panel of the chosen or pinned workflow's prompts and writes the answers back as the item's input. | [VM with Workflow](forms/FRM-j7w530h7/) |
| tfcBuildDay2Panel | [FJS-ylyi1tc0](form_functions/FJS-ylyi1tc0/) | Async form function for the shared Terraform Update form: fetches the resource's variables panel from the form-options webhook and installs it as the empty Dynamic Panel's template. | [Terraform Update](forms/FRM-h4py5w3a/) |
